title: abutilon obtusum
intro: Abutilon obtusum, commonly known as the prickly okra or okra bush, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Abutilon obtusum include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Abutilon obtusum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
